items.name: c-move
items.subject: MOVE: one sturdy armoured boot of dark leather with a polished steel toe cap and greave, mid-stride toward the upper right, a short soft dust trail behind its heel.

items.name: c-attack
items.subject: ATTACK: a broad steel sword with a bronze crossguard and leather grip, blade pointing diagonally up to the upper right, a bright glint running along its edge.

items.name: c-stop
items.subject: STOP: a round steel shield with a bronze rim and a central boss, seen head-on, filling the middle of the frame.

items.name: c-hold
items.subject: HOLD POSITION: a steel-tipped spear planted upright in the ground with a small round bronze-rimmed shield leaning against its shaft.

items.name: c-patrol
items.subject: PATROL: two curved bronze arrows chasing each other around a circle, forming a closed loop, with a soft warm glow in the middle.

items.name: c-follow
items.subject: FOLLOW: a trail of three insect footprints pressed into dark soil, leading from the lower left to the upper right, each lit by a faint golden glow, the farthest one smallest.

items.name: c-build
items.subject: BUILD: a heavy builder's hammer with a dark stone-and-bronze head and a leather-wrapped wooden handle, angled diagonally, a few wood shavings.

items.name: c-build-advanced
items.subject: BUILD ADVANCED STRUCTURE: a heavy bronze-headed hammer crossed with a steel carpenter's square over a rolled-out parchment building plan.

items.name: c-produce
items.subject: PRODUCE: a dark iron anvil with a glowing orange-hot piece of metal on it and a small burst of sparks.

items.name: c-rally
items.subject: SET RALLY POINT: a small swallow-tailed cream cloth flag on a wooden pole planted in the ground, flapping in the wind, a soft golden glow at its base.

items.name: c-pause
items.subject: PAUSE: two thick upright bronze bars side by side, polished, with bevelled edges.

items.name: c-cancel
items.subject: CANCEL: a bold X of two crossed iron bars enamelled deep red, with bronze rivets at the crossing.

items.name: c-camera
items.subject: CAMERA: a brass spyglass with leather bands, extended, angled diagonally, a deep blue lens glinting at its wide end.

items.name: s-armor-light
items.subject: LIGHT ARMOUR (a stat icon): a padded brown leather jerkin with stitched seams and a few small bronze studs, seen from the front.

items.name: s-armor-heavy
items.subject: HEAVY ARMOUR (a stat icon): a polished steel breastplate with layered pauldrons and bronze edging, seen from the front.

items.name: s-armor-structure
items.subject: FORTIFIED (a stat icon for buildings' armour): a short section of thick fitted grey stone wall with a crenellated top and iron bands.
